answer: One concrete mechanism: score token-distribution divergence against the identity's own answer history. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The prism of work and the river of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a willow to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
